name: 타락한 로키
subject: An adult male corrupted Loki with long black hair fading dark green, green eyes, narrow knowing smile, small asymmetric gold horn circlet. Layered forest-green and black fitted robes and ragged dark cape with violet inner lining, boots. One hand holds a small mistletoe arrow; the other grips a narrow dark bow beside the thigh. Elegant slight side-on standing pose with natural head angle, no forced neck bend. A restrained purple ember curls around the arrow. Darker, more sinister silhouette than player Loki.
